City id brussels is unused in existing packs. Display Brussels. Agency STIB/MIVB. Do not invent city=bru, city=bruxelles, city=stib, or merge into another Belgian city. Sweden out. Do not edit Perth. Do not flip live.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: metro 1, 2, 5, 6 only. Tracker M1–M6 overstates — there is no passenger metro 3 or 4 on the official map. OUT: tram; premetro (North–South Axis underground tram); CHRONO T 4 7 8 9 10 on this plate; bus; Noctis; SNCB/NMBS S-lines; De Lijn; TEC. Metro 3 Albert–Bordet is a frozen project — official Albert district text prints “No metro lines available”. Out until the official metro map says open.
Timezone Europe/Brussels HAS DST (CEST/CET). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.

Four printed metro lines on the official legend: 1 Gare de l'Ouest / Weststation – Stockel / Stokkel (21); 2 Simonis – Elisabeth (19); 5 Erasme / Erasmus – Herrmann-Debroux (28); 6 Roi Baudouin / Koning Boudewijn – Elisabeth (26). 60 unique open metro stop strings after dedupe. 94 line ticks. Simonis and Elisabeth are two names (line 2 loop ends).

Locked inner-city printed name: Arts-Loi / Kunst-Wet (metro 1 × 2 × 5 × 6; official district-map text at every exit; no tram). Not Gare du Midi / Zuidstation, not Gare Centrale / Centraal Station, not De Brouckère, not Rogier, not Gare du Nord / Noordstation, not Simonis, not Elisabeth, not Downtown / Centre / Centrum, not Beekkant, not Gare de l'Ouest / Weststation. Arts-Loi / Kunst-Wet is a hub stop string, not a direction token.

Bilingual lock is FR / NL with a slash, matching the clash report (Arts-Loi / Kunst-Wet, Gare du Midi / Zuidstation). The map often stacks both languages (sometimes NL above FR). One D1 string per station; the other stack order is a rename in hazards, not a second stop. Same-in-both-languages names stay single (Beekkant, De Brouckère, Simonis, Elisabeth, Schuman, …).

doNotGroup Simonis ≠ Elisabeth (two printed terminus boxes on the same complex). doNotGroup metro vs SNCB at Gare du Midi / Zuidstation, Gare Centrale / Centraal Station, Schuman, Merode, Bockstael. doNotGroup metro vs North–South Axis premetro at Rogier, De Brouckère, Gare du Midi, Porte de Hal. Gare du Nord / Noordstation has no metro.
